name: Patent Scout
description: 🚀 AI-powered patent analyzer: Instantly evaluate invention

paragraphs: PatentScout is your AI-powered partner for innovation. Built on the cutting-edge Model Context Protocol (MCP), it does what no ordinary patent search can: it deeply understands your idea, scours global patent databases with precision, and delivers a smart, contextual evaluation of how original, unique and defensible your concept really is. It doesn’t just search — it thinks.

•⁠ ⁠Conducts deep, context-aware searches across global patent databases •⁠ ⁠Evaluates the originality and defensibility of your idea •⁠ ⁠Identifies relevant prior art to give you a clear competitive picture •⁠ ⁠Provides an intelligent analysis of strengths, weaknesses and an overall patentability score •⁠ ⁠Helps you move fast, avoid legal risks and invest where it truly matters
Whether you're a founder, researcher or corporate innovator, PatentScout helps you instantly know if your idea is worth pursuing.
